title: Set-owned records service: real REST adapter + mapper + copy idempotency against /plant-products/notifications
recipe: src/server/app/docs/add-a-set.md STEP 8 (set services — the port-op→HTTP table and the Idempotency-Key copy contract are named there by ruling R6), with SIBLING-SET-PLAN.md §6.2 as revised 2026-08-01 (R4) supplying the CHED-PP op table. §8 G-D still records that no in-repo records-adapter recipe pre-existed; exemplars are the live-animals records files named in notes.

filesToTouch.what: Exports: backendBaseUrl = process.env.TRADE_IMPORTS_ANIMALS_BACKEND_URL ?? 'http://localhost:8085' (same backend process hosts /plant-products); notificationsUrl = `${backendBaseUrl}/plant-products/notifications`; tracingHeader = process.env.TRACING_HEADER ?? 'x-cdp-request-id'; IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_HEADER = 'Idempotency-Key' (R4 — the exact header name the live-animals backend uses, FulfilmentController.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY); HTTP_NOT_FOUND = 404. Mirror of L2 services/persistence/records/real/config.js minus the projection URLs.

Exports mapStatus(backendStatus) mapping the backend enum to the engine constants imported from src/server/app/engine/persistence/records.js: 'DRAFT'→DRAFT('draft'), 'SUBMITTED'→SUBMITTED('submitted'), 'AMEND'→AMEND('amend'), 'DELETED'→DELETED('deleted'); unknown value throws (loud, never a silent default). Also exports BACKEND_STATUS = { SUBMITTED, AMEND, DELETED } used by the transition ops. Exemplar: L2 real/status.js.

Exports marshal(dto) → the engine journey record { journeyId: dto.referenceNumber, status: mapStatus(dto.status), createdAt: dto.created ?? null, submittedAt: status===SUBMITTED ? (dto.declaration?.declaredAt ?? null) : null, fulfilment: assembleFulfilments(fromDto(dto)) } — assembleFulfilments from src/server/app/bridge/assemble-fulfilments.js (legal set→L2 import), fromDto from ./mapper/from-dto.js. Also exports marshalListItem(dto) → { journeyId, status, createdAt, submittedAt } (mirror L2 real/marshal/list-item.js; pp-037 extends when the dashboard needs more columns).

Exports `records` = { create, load, list, has, replaceFulfilment, finalise, amend, cancelAmend, copy, softDelete, clear } implementing the engine port (surface pinned by src/server/app/engine/persistence/records.js) via global fetch against config.js URLs, per the §6.2 op→HTTP table: create(_options) POST notificationsUrl body '{}', expect 201, return marshal(body) — journeyId IS the minted GBN-PP referenceNumber; load({ journeyId }) GET …/{journeyId}, 404→undefined, 200→marshal; list({ page=1, sort='arrivalDate,desc', referenceNumber }) GET with query string, map the page response → { rows: content.map(marshalListItem), page, size, totalElements, totalPages }; has(journeyId) GET → 200 true / 404 false; replaceFulfilment(journeyId, fulfilment, { known }={}) — resolve status (use `known` when supplied else GET), assert writable (draft|amend else throw), body = toDto(projectAnswers(structuredClone(fulfilment ?? {}))), PUT …/{journeyId}, 200|201 → marshal; finalise/amend/cancelAmend/softDelete via PUT …/{journeyId}/status with {status:'SUBMITTED'} / {status:'AMEND'} / {status:'SUBMITTED', discardChanges:true} / {status:'DELETED'}; clear() throws 'records.clear is not supported in real mode'. **COPY — R4, the change of record for this increment:** `copy(journeyId, idempotencyKey)` POSTs …/{journeyId}/copies with the header `Idempotency-Key: <idempotencyKey>` ALWAYS set, expects 201 and marshals the new documentless DRAFT. The key is REQUIRED: reject a missing/blank key locally, before any request, with a clear error ('Idempotency-Key must not be blank' — the same voice the live-animals backend uses), so a caller that forgets it fails loudly at the seam instead of minting duplicate drafts. The engine port already carries the key — engine/journey.js copyJourney(request, h, journeyId, idempotencyKey) — so this is a straight transposition of the live-animals frontend behaviour (services/persistence/records/real/lifecycle/create.js sends the header) onto the NOTIFICATION resource. TRANSPOSE THE PATTERN, NOT THE CODE: live-animals implements idempotency on the FULFILMENT resource; here /copies hangs off the notification. Every non-ok response (other than the handled 404s) throws via a failed(operation, response) helper; all requests send content-type application/json + the tracing header. Helpers stay inside real.js — records/ is flat per the plan's §1 tree.

Op→HTTP contract unit test: mock global fetch at the NETWORK boundary (same technique as L2 real.requests.test.js — never module-mock). One test per op asserting method, URL (incl. query-string shape for list), body (create sends '{}'; replaceFulfilment body has NO server-set fields; status ops send exactly {status} / {status, discardChanges:true}) and the marshalled return shape. R4 cases: copy sends the Idempotency-Key header with exactly the value passed in; copy with a missing/blank key throws BEFORE issuing any fetch (assert zero fetch calls by observing that no request was recorded, not by call-spying on a module); a repeated copy with the SAME key still issues the request (dedupe is the server's job in real mode) and marshals whatever the backend returns. Negative paths: load/has 404 → undefined/false; non-ok elsewhere throws naming the op; replaceFulfilment against SUBMITTED/DELETED throws without issuing the PUT; clear throws.

Upgrade the pp-007 boot-minimum stub to full semantic parity with real. In-memory Map keyed by journeyId; per-record { journeyId, status, createdAt, submittedAt, fulfilment, submittedSnapshot? }. Reference minting: GBN-PP-{YY}-{6 Crockford base32 chars} matching ^GBN-PP-\d{2}-[0-9A-HJ-KM-NP-TV-Z]{6}$. Status-transition legality mirroring the backend §3.1 table exactly: finalise only from draft|amend → submitted (sets submittedAt, drops snapshot); amend only from submitted → amend (captures submittedSnapshot); cancelAmend only from amend with a snapshot → restores fulfilment+submittedAt, back to submitted; softDelete from draft|submitted|amend → deleted, idempotent; anything else throws. replaceFulfilment guards writable (draft|amend) and stores a structuredClone. list hides deleted, 1-based paging with the same envelope as real, referenceNumber filter. clear() empties the store AND its dedupe index. **COPY — R4:** `copy(journeyId, idempotencyKey)` mirrors the real contract with a DEDUPE KEY: reject a missing/blank key with the same error real.js raises; keep a Map from the dedupe key to the minted copy's journeyId and RETURN THE EXISTING COPY on a repeat rather than minting a second draft — the live-animals reference behaviour (FulfilmentService.copy() looks up findByCopyIdempotencyKey first and returns the existing copy, re-checking after a DuplicateKeyException). Scope the dedupe key to the SOURCE REFERENCE (`${journeyId}:${idempotencyKey}`), so the same key used against a different source notification legitimately mints a new draft — that is the live-animals unique-partial-index semantic ('copy_idempotency_key' over copyIdempotencyKey) transposed. The copy is a fresh DRAFT with a new ref, documentless, carrying no submittedSnapshot/submittedAt (D-19).

Pins the stub-only semantics not covered by the shared port suite: minted refs match the GBN-PP pattern and are unique; the five-row transition-legality table (each illegal transition throws); amend snapshot capture then cancelAmend restore round-trip; list paging/filter/deleted-hidden; clear resets store and dedupe index. R4 cases: copy with a blank key throws; two copies of the same source with the SAME key return ONE draft (same journeyId, and the store holds exactly one new record); two copies of the same source with DIFFERENT keys mint two drafts; the same key against a DIFFERENT source mints a new draft (dedupe is scoped to the source reference); a copy does not share mutable state with its source.

Rewrite as the stub/real switch (mirror L2 services/persistence/records/index.js verbatim): import { isRealMode } from '../mode.js'; import { records as stubRecords } from './stub.js'; import { records as realRecords } from './real.js'; export const records = isRealMode() ? realRecords : stubRecords. (pp-007 shipped this file stub-only; FD-6: PLANT_PRODUCTS_MODE default 'real'.) This module is what routes-plant-products.js passes to configureRecords('plant-products', records) — the set id is supplied by the gateway, not here.

Exports toDto(answers) mapping the ANSWERS TREE → PlantProductsNotificationDto body (camelCase, D-10). At pp-008 the plant manifest is empty and importType/declaration are flow-only session keys (FD-8), so the m0 mapping is {} — but the module establishes the growth structure: a top-level toDto composing per-area section functions (empty registry at m0) so each m2+ page increment adds one section mapping. HARD RULES baked in and asserted in mapper.test.js: never emit server-set fields (referenceNumber, status, chedType, ownership, created, updated, expireAt, submittedBaseline); never invent a payload property for an answer with no backend home (explicit omission assertion instead); accompanyingDocuments group members are NEVER part of the PUT body (they project onto the sub-resource — FD-11, pp-034).

Exports fromDto(dto) inverting to-dto: DTO → answers tree for draft resume (marshal.js then runs assembleFulfilments over it). m0 behaviour: server-set and unknown fields dropped; empty/blank dto → {}. Explicitly IGNORES the embedded accompanyingDocuments array on the GET response at pp-008 (asserted omission — folding is pp-034's, FD-11). Same section-function growth structure as to-dto.

Pins: toDto({}) === {}; round-trip fromDto(toDto(answers)) on the m0 answers tree; server-set-field omission (no referenceNumber/status/chedType/ownership/created/updated/expireAt/submittedBaseline keys even when present on input); fromDto drops server-set + unknown fields and ignores embedded accompanyingDocuments. Standing home for every later increment's mapping + omission tests.

Dual-implementation engine-port contract suite, pattern copied from L2 src/server/app/services/persistence/records/records-port.test.js (read it first and mirror its structure): ONE shared spec run against BOTH the stub and the network-mocked real impl, proving identical observable semantics — create returns a draft with a journeyId; load round-trips what replaceFulfilment saved; has true/false; finalise→submitted, amend→amend, cancelAmend restores the submitted fulfilment, softDelete→deleted idempotent; replaceFulfilment on a non-writable record rejects. **R4 — the two copy-idempotency pins the ruling names, and they are the reason this suite is load-bearing for pp-045:** (1) 'one new draft per idempotency key' — copying the same source twice with the same key yields ONE new draft (the second call returns the first copy's journeyId), and twice with different keys yields two; (2) 'copy idempotency scoped to the source reference' — the same key against a different source notification mints a new draft. Under the network-mocked real impl these are asserted at the request level (the header is sent verbatim on every call and the server's response is trusted); under the stub they are asserted at the semantic level (the dedupe index dedupes). Record in the file header that real-mode dedupe is only genuinely enforced once the backend honours the header — see openQuestions.

Extend the standing co-residency suite (created pp-006, plant half pp-007) with the RECORDS-SEAM case this increment makes provable: in ONE booted server with both gateways registered, a plant request resolves the SET-OWNED plant records impl while a live-animals request resolves the L2 live-animals impl — assert through observable behaviour (a plant create mints a GBN-PP-pattern reference; a live-animals create mints its own reference shape; neither appears in the other's list) rather than by inspecting the registry. Also pin the P-2 negative: with per-set keying the plant slot of configureCommodityReference is ABSENT, so a plant-context call into the L2 notification-mapper throws loudly rather than silently mapping with live-animals vocabulary.

schemaFields: referenceNumber (read: becomes the engine journeyId; NEVER sent in a body — path-driven per §6.2)
status (read via GET; written only via PUT …/{ref}/status with SUBMITTED | AMEND | DELETED | SUBMITTED+discardChanges)

Idempotency-Key (REQUEST HEADER on POST …/{ref}/copies — R4; minted per rendered copy action by pp-045, carried through engine copyJourney(request, h, journeyId, idempotencyKey), sent verbatim by real.js, deduped by stub.js against `${sourceRef}:${key}`)
whole-document content fields via PUT …/{reference-number} (empty body at m0; grows per increment through mapper section functions)
server-set, never sent: chedType, ownership.assignedOrganisationId, ownership.assignedOrganisationName, created, updated, expireAt, submittedBaseline
list envelope: GET …?page&sort&referenceNumber → content/page/pageSize/totalElements/totalPages (1-based; DELETED hidden server-side)
accompanyingDocuments (embedded on GET response — explicitly ignored at pp-008; sub-resource projection owned by pp-034 per FD-11)
specs: NONE new Playwright — service-layer increment with no UI surface. Coverage is unit-level: real.test.js (network-boundary op→HTTP contract incl. the Idempotency-Key header), stub.test.js (transition legality, minting, copy dedupe), mapper/mapper.test.js (round-trip + omission), records-port.test.js (stub/real parity incl. the two R4 copy-idempotency pins).
src/server/app/co-residency.test.js — EXTENDED here with the per-set records-seam case and the P-2 absent-slot negative
acceptanceCriteria: real.js implements all 11 engine-port ops with exactly the §6.2 op→HTTP mapping (asserted per-op in real.test.js against a network-boundary fetch mock): POST create, GET load/has, GET list with query params, PUT whole-document replaceFulfilment, PUT …/status for finalise/amend/cancelAmend(discardChanges:true)/softDelete, POST …/copies for copy.

R4 COPY IDEMPOTENCY — FRONTEND SIDE COMPLETE HERE, BEFORE THE COPY BUTTON: real.js sends `Idempotency-Key: <key>` on every POST …/{ref}/copies and refuses a missing/blank key locally with 'Idempotency-Key must not be blank' before issuing any request; stub.js mirrors it with a dedupe index scoped to `${sourceReference}:${key}` and returns the EXISTING copy on a repeat.
records-port.test.js pins, against BOTH impls: 'one new draft per idempotency key' and 'copy idempotency scoped to the source reference'. pp-045 may not ship the Copy button until these are green.

Every op returns the engine journey record shape { journeyId, status, createdAt, submittedAt, fulfilment } with journeyId = the backend referenceNumber (GBN-PP-…), status one of the lowercase engine constants, and fulfilment the obligation-id-keyed map from assembleFulfilments(fromDto(dto)).

load returns undefined and has returns false on backend 404; every other non-ok response throws an error naming the operation; replaceFulfilment refuses (throws before any PUT) when the record status is not draft/amend; clear() throws in real mode and resets the store in stub mode.

toDto output never contains referenceNumber, status, chedType, ownership, created, updated, expireAt or submittedBaseline; fromDto ignores embedded accompanyingDocuments — pinned by explicit assertions in mapper.test.js.

stub.js enforces the backend §3.1 status-transition table, captures/restores the amend snapshot, mints unique GBN-PP-pattern references, hides deleted from list, supports 1-based paging + referenceNumber filter, and copy yields a fresh documentless draft.

PER-SET RECORDS SEAM (co-residency): in ONE booted server with both gateways registered, a plant request resolves the set-owned plant records impl and a live-animals request resolves the L2 live-animals impl — proven in co-residency.test.js by observable behaviour, not by registry inspection. Neither set's notifications appear in the other's list.

Two-sided verification (co-residency form): npm run test:live-animals, npm test and the live-animals Playwright suites are green with no test-count drop, AND co-residency.test.js is green — both sets serving correctly from the same running process, not two separate boots.

notes: AMENDED 2026-08-01 for Sam's rulings R3 (co-residency) and R4 (copy idempotency). TWO CHANGES. (1) THE RECORDS SEAM IS KEYED BY SET. configureRecords now takes setId as its first argument (pp-056/P-9), so the plant impl is not 'the' records impl but 'the plant records impl' — and that is now PROVABLE rather than conventional: co-residency.test.js gains a case showing a plant request resolving the set-owned impl while a live-animals request resolves the L2 one, in one process, with neither set's notifications visible to the other. The P-2 containment claim likewise strengthens from 'we do not call configureCommodityReference on the plant path' to 'the plant slot is ABSENT, so a plant request reaching the L2 mapper throws loudly instead of silently mapping with live-animals vocabulary' — added as a negative test. (2) R4 LANDS HERE, NOT WITH THE COPY BUTTON. The round-1 plan of this increment explicitly sent NO Idempotency-Key on POST …/copies and raised it as an open question. Sam has ruled: match what live-animals already does, exactly, on both sides, sequenced BEFORE pp-045 ships the Copy button. Live-animals reference implementation, for transposition: BACKEND — FulfilmentController.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY = 'Idempotency-Key' as a REQUIRED @RequestHeader, blank rejected with BadRequestException('Idempotency-Key must not be blank'); Fulfilment carries copyIdempotencyKey with a unique PARTIAL index (name 'copy_idempotency_key', def {'copyIdempotencyKey':1}, partialFilter {'copyIdempotencyKey':{'$type':'string'}}); FulfilmentService.copy() looks up findByCopyIdempotencyKey FIRST and returns the existing copy on a repeat, re-checking after a DuplicateKeyException. FRONTEND — a randomUUID() minted per RENDERED copy action (features/dashboard/view-model/row/actions.js and features/check-answers/controller.js), carried in a hidden input named idempotencyKey, sent as the Idempotency-Key header by services/persistence/records/real/lifecycle/create.js, mirrored in the stub adapter with a dedupe key, with records-port contract tests pinning 'one new draft per idempotency key' and 'copy idempotency scoped to the source reference'. **TRANSPOSE THE PATTERN, NOT THE CODE:** live-animals implements this on the FULFILMENT resource; the plant-products design puts /copies on the NOTIFICATION resource, so the dedupe key is scoped to the source NOTIFICATION reference and the stored key belongs on the notification document. THIS increment owns the frontend half — adapter, stub dedupe, port contract tests. pp-045 owns only the UI half (mint per rendered action, hidden input, pass through copyJourney) and its increment body now says so. The BACKEND half is a REQUIRED, currently-unplanned work item: the Phase-B /plant-products/notifications/{ref}/copies endpoint as built by pp-001 accepts no such header, so real-mode dedupe is not yet enforced server-side — see openQuestions; the frontend contract is nonetheless complete and stub-proven, and the header is sent unconditionally so the backend change is additive. PORT CONTRACT (verified live): engine/persistence/records.js pins the 11 op names; engine/store.js + write/pipeline/canonical.js consume records as { journeyId, status, createdAt, submittedAt, fulfilment }; engine/journey.js copyJourney(request, h, journeyId, idempotencyKey) ALREADY carries the key, so no engine change is needed. RETAINED HEADLESS DECISIONS: journeyId ≡ backend referenceNumber; submittedAt from declaration.declaredAt; backend base URL reuses TRADE_IMPORTS_ANIMALS_BACKEND_URL (the plant surface lives in the same backend app); real clear() THROWS per §6.2 (recorded deviation from the L2 no-op); the FD-11 documents projection is a deliberate no-op pinned by omission assertions (pp-034 owns it); records/ stays flat. EXEMPLARS (read before writing): src/server/app/engine/persistence/records.js; src/server/app/services/persistence/records/{index.js, records-port.test.js, real/config.js, real/status.js, real/lifecycle/create.js (THE Idempotency-Key exemplar), real/lifecycle/read.js, real/lifecycle/mutate.js, real/lifecycle/transition.js, real/marshal/*, real/write-guards/*, real/real.requests.test.js, stub/lifecycle/transition.js, stub/reference-number.js}; src/server/app/bridge/assemble-fulfilments.js; src/server/app/bridge/fulfilments/index.js. Rulings applied: R3, R4, FD-5, FD-6, FD-11, FD-14 (per-set seams), D-4, D-19, Open Q 3, §8 G-D.
openQuestions: OVERLAP TO RESOLVE BEFORE BUILD (raised 2026-08-01, concurrent re-plan): the backend half of R4 is now scheduled as pp-054 ('Backend: copy idempotency — Idempotency-Key on POST /plant-products/notifications/{ref}/copies', dependsOn pp-002), which is what this increment's earlier open question asked for — required @RequestHeader('Idempotency-Key') with blank rejected as 'Idempotency-Key must not be blank'; copyIdempotencyKey on the notification with a unique PARTIAL index (name 'copy_idempotency_key', def {'copyIdempotencyKey':1}, partialFilter {'copyIdempotencyKey':{'$type':'string'}}); service copy() looking up findByCopyIdempotencyKey first, returning the existing copy on a repeat and re-checking after a DuplicateKeyException. GOOD. But a FRONTEND increment pp-055 was also created for the same frontend work this increment now carries (real + stub Idempotency-Key, records-port contract tests). ONE of them must own it: either fold pp-055 into pp-008 and delete it, or narrow pp-008 back to the adapter plumbing and let pp-055 own the dedupe semantics + contract tests. RECOMMENDATION — keep it here (the adapter, its stub and its port contract are one seam and splitting them means shipping a copy op that is knowingly non-idempotent for one increment), narrow pp-055 to 'verify real-mode dedupe end-to-end against pp-054's backend + the Copy-button rendering contract', and repoint pp-045's dependsOn accordingly. Do NOT build both.

Real-mode dedupe is only genuinely enforced once pp-054 lands; until then the frontend contract is complete and stub-proven, and the header is sent unconditionally so the backend change is purely additive. pp-045 must not ship the Copy button before pp-054 and the records-port pins here are both green.

Backend PUT …/{reference-number} body carries NO referenceNumber (§6.2: path-driven) but §3.1 says 'ref must match path' — confirm the mismatch guard tolerates an ABSENT body ref (it should only fire on a present, differing value). pp-004's PlantProductsNotificationIT should pin this; if the backend 400s on absence, the one-line fix is real.js setting body.referenceNumber = journeyId.

submittedAt sourced from declaration.declaredAt is only populated when the frontend persists declaration at finalise (pp-039) — until then submitted records marshal with submittedAt null; confirm the pp-037 dashboard renders that gap acceptably in the interim.
